snapshot.sourceRefCoverageManifestMeaning: distinct source-ref strings; not row coverage

reasons: The frozen snapshot selected the historical/transition halfvec column, not the canonical vector(768) target column.
The producer is a mutable model tag rather than an immutable model digest.
The snapshot manifest does not carry per-row model, source, workspace, or representation revisions.

This current live readback supersedes historical ledger statements that latent_128 or latent_256 columns were absent; those statements describe earlier states or were incorrect for this readback.

snapshotOrdinalCrosswalk.method: Read-only CTE joined each frozen ordinal-map UUID to codebase_chunk_index.id, atlas_packet_chunk_lineage.chunk_row_id, atlas_packets.packet_key, and atlas_workspace_source_bindings using exact source revision and packet workspace revision.
snapshotOrdinalCrosswalk.exactBindingDefinition: PROVEN lineage; map path, chunk source_ref, lineage source_ref, and packet source_ref agree; packet and lineage source revisions agree; one source binding matches the same source revision and packet workspace_revision_key and has content_digest.
snapshotOrdinalCrosswalk.sourceByteAndPacketSpanVerification: NOT_PROVEN; packet byte_start/byte_end are absent or invalid for all 8,863 exact packet-binding rows. A separate AST observation join is reported below and does not establish that source bytes were reopened during this audit.

astObservationCrosswalk.owner: public.atlas_ast_nodes via existing Atlas AST evidence reader contract
astObservationCrosswalk.method: Read-only join of the 8,863 exact snapshot/chunk/packet/workspace-binding candidates to AST observations by relative_path and exact source_revision; compared AST source_content_hash with the unique workspace binding content_digest.
limitations: The 1,676 path/revision candidate intersection was checked against the 8,863 packet/binding set, but candidate-to-AST identity is not established: packet tree_node_id matched zero AST tree_node_id values, packet workspace_id matched zero AST workspace_id values, and source-ref/repository identity joins matched zero.
Only 59 candidate IDs have exactly one AST row under the path/revision join; the other 1,617 have multiple AST rows and must not be resolved by arbitrary selection.
The AST table match is path and revision qualified, but this audit did not reopen the underlying file bytes.
Packet byte spans remain unverified; AST node spans are observations and were not independently checked against current source bytes.
The snapshot vectors still lack immutable per-row embedding-model and representation revisions; AST linkage does not establish vector producer lineage.

currentSnapshotRowMetadataReadback.meaningOfEmbeddingVersionValues: NOT_ESTABLISHED; do not assume these are immutable model digests.

conclusion: The frozen matrix is numerically 768-wide and its ordinal map is structurally complete. All 55,169 UUIDs currently resolve to chunk rows and all 52,380 non-null map paths match those rows. Of these, 8,863 satisfy the exact packet/source-binding crosswalk. A path/source-revision join yields 1,676 AST candidates whose stored AST hashes equal the workspace binding digest, but this does not establish AST identity: only 59 candidates have one matching AST row; packet tree-node, workspace, source-ref/repository and binding-repository joins all match zero. No current source bytes were reopened; packet spans remain invalid; vectors lack immutable per-row embedding-model and representation revisions; and only 15 crosswalk rows currently have a canonical vector(768) value. Do not use this historical cohort for production-qualified v2/v3 comparison, retrieval promotion, or materialization. Re-exporting a separately qualified cohort may be safer than treating historical matrix membership as current lineage.
nextSafeGate: Use the existing AST/source owner to prove current bytes and byte spans for any candidate; independently bind the historical vector value to immutable model/input revisions. If the old halfvec cohort cannot be so proven, export a new frozen cohort from content_embedding_768 with qualified identity and independent readback.
